config.trial_key_rule: physical trial = (subject_id, original_trial_id + 4*y_true); used only to average inner-OOF teacher probabilities inside outer-training subjects
config.teacher_rule: inner subject-stratified 5-fold (seed 2054) OOF HGB window probabilities on outer-training subjects; t = mean over the window's physical trial
config.soft_target_rule: soft = 0.5*y + 0.5*t; student = same HGB on duplicated rows (label 1 weight soft, label 0 weight 1-soft)
config.confidence_weight_rule: w = 0.25 + 0.75*(t if y==1 else 1-t), normalized to mean 1; hard labels
config.decision: accept a method only if repeat-mean AUC gain >= +0.005 vs control AND repeat-mean F1 not lower AND repeat-mean DEP AUC not lower; otherwise stop, no tuning
